verdict.rationale: Omnara's evidence covers launching, monitoring, and remote-controlling agents (via dashboard/CLI/API/SDK) and connecting to a machine you own, but there's no documentation of the agent autonomously cloning a repo, installing dependencies, or self-configuring its own working environment — that setup appears to remain the developer's responsibility. Missing for 10: any mention of automated repo cloning, dependency installation, or environment bootstrap by the agent itself.
